To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a simple approach to query expansion using a small number of relevant documents can improve retrieval performance and (2) a simple approach that combines evidence from multiple sources (title, body, and anchor text) to estimate the relevance of a document can significantly improve performance.
(a) The use of a single large training corpus is more effective than the use of many smaller training corpora.
In summary, our research is concerned with

developing a question-answering system that can be used to answer a wide range of factoid questions over a broad set of documents, and is capable of handling a wide range of question types, including questions with negation, quantification, comparison and other linguistic phenomena.
the development of a question-answering (QA) system that uses the Internet as its knowledge source, and that is able to provide answers in a natural language.
the development of an information retrieval system which can answer complex questions posed by users.
